jobs.occupation: University Professor of Functional Genomics and Molecular Neurobiology (Professor/in - Hochschulen)
jobs.description:
Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz (JGU) is one of the largest universities in Germany. Thanks to its location in the Rhine-Main science region – home to the RMU Alliance formed by JGU, Goethe University, and TU Darmstadt – JGU can utilize its full potential and showcase its dynamic, innovative power. Its status as a comprehensive university allows for multidisciplinary learning and teaching at JGU, in turn, paving the way for internationally renowned, interdisciplinary research. Almost all of its faculties and departments are located on a single campus close to the Mainz city center, creating a lively academic culture for researchers, teaching staff, and students from all over the world.

The Institute of Developmental Biology and Neurobiology at the Faculty of Biology invites applications for the position of a

University Professor of Functional Genomics and Molecular Neurobiology

beginning at the earliest date possible. Salary grade W 2 LBesG | Civil servant (tenured)

Tasks and expectations:

We seek an outstanding candidate with a strong expertise in genetics and molecular biology, including the application of these approaches to the nervous system. Internationally recognised expertise and a strong track record of successfully securing external funding are required. Collaboration within the Faculty of Biology, the University Medical Centre, the Institute of Molecular Biology (IMB) and participation in current and future research consortia is expected.

The successful candidate will receive departmental positions and start-up funds and will be expected to establish an independent and internationally visible research program sustained by third party funding. Examples of further cooperation opportunities include: Institute of Quantitative and Computational Biosciences (IQCB) as well as collaborative research centres (e.g. CRC 1361 DNA Repair & Genome Stability; CRC 1551 Polymer Concepts in Cellular Function), the Research Unit FOR 5289 (From Imprecision to Robustness in Neural Circuit Assembly), or the Research Training Groups 4R (R-Loop Regulation in Robustness and Resilience) and GenEvo (Gene regulation in Evolution), the Carl-Zeiss-funded project for Interactive Bio-materials for Neural Regeneration and profile areas such as ReALity (Resilience - Adaptation - Longevity) or the Centre of Healthy Aging (further details here). The Rhine-Main Neuroscience Network (rmn²) offers further collaboration opportunities within the Rhine Main region.

Finally, the successful candidate will teach practical and theoretical courses in genetics, molecular biology and neurobiology at the Bachelor’s and Master’s level. We seek to increase the number of courses taught in English. Teaching is conducted in English and, in the basic Bachelor modules, in German. Applicants are therefore expected to be proficient in English and German. German language skills need to be acquired within five years of appointment. Participation in academic service is expected.

Requirements:

- In addition to the general requirements according to public services law, applicants must meet the recruitment requirements stipulated in Section 49 of the Hochschulgesetz of Rhineland-Palatinate. 
- In addition to the doctorate, a demonstration of excellent academic achievements is required. 

The state of Rhineland-Palatinate and JGU are committed to close personal mentoring of students and expect teaching staff to have a strong presence on campus. A cooperative, team-oriented and proactive work attitude, strong communication skills, and the willingness to assume responsibility – including further professional development in accordance with JGU’s leadership guidelines – is also expected.

Commitments of JGU:

JGU firmly supports making family and career compatible and promotes its employees’ further professional development. JGU welcomes qualified applications from people from diverse backgrounds. JGU aims to increase the number of women in research and teaching and therefore encourages female researchers to apply.

Candidates with severe disabilities or with equivalent status (as defined by section 2 subsection 3 of the Ninth Book of the Social Code, SGB IX) and appropriate qualifications will be given priority.

Please upload your complete application information and documents (CV, references, diplomas and certificates, as well as lists of publications and teaching activities, funding record, current research and future research plans, teaching concept) no later than September 30, 2026 via our portal with the following link: (https://berufungsportal.uni-mainz.de/datenabfrage/Genomics_Neurobiology)

https://berufungsportal.uni-mainz.de/datenabfrage/Genomics_Neurobiology (https://berufungsportal.uni-mainz.de/datenabfrage/Genomics_Neurobiology)

The interview symposium is tentatively planned for November 2026.

For questions and further information, please contact the chairperson of the search committee Prof. Martin Heine (marthein@uni-mainz.de).

Information on data protection: https://karriere.uni-mainz.de/en/#hinweise-zum-datenschutz (https://karriere.uni-mainz.de/en/#hinweise-zum-datenschutz)

jobs.occupation: Professorship in One Health, Animal Hygiene and Animal Disease Control (W3) (Professor/in - Hochschulen)
jobs.description:
The Faculty of Veterinary Medicine seeks to fill the mentioned above professorship at the earliest opportunity:

Academic context
Founded in 1409, the University of Leipzig is one of Germany's largest, most research-intensive and leading medical universities. It offers a dynamic and international working environment as well as attractive and diverse career opportunities in research, teaching, transfer, infrastructure and administration. The Faculty of Veterinary Medicine serves as a centre for interdisciplinary research in the fields of animal health, veterinary public health, public health and One Health.

The Institute of Animal Hygiene and Public Veterinary Services is a member of the Centre for Veterinary Public Health at the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine. It has modern BSL-2 (Biosafety Level 2) laboratory facilities, an interdisciplinary research environment and a wide-ranging international network.

Future Duties
The professorship is responsible for independently representing the field of animal hygiene and animal disease control in teaching [in accordance with § 32 "Animal husbandry and animal hygiene" and § 39 "Animal disease control and infectious disease epidemiology" of the Ordinance on the Licensing of Veterinarians (Verordnung zur Approbation von Tierärztinnen und Tierärzten – TAppV)], research and services. In the subject of animal disease control, teaching is carried out in cooperation with the Centre for Infectious Diseases (Zentrum für Infektionsmedizin – ZIM). The professorship is also responsible for managing the Institute of Animal Hygiene and Veterinary Public Health.

The professorship is expected to strengthen the faculty's research profile, especially the One Health approach, and to focus on the rapid detection and containment of infectious diseases in animals, animal epidemics and zoonoses (Pandemic Preparedness). Compatibility and collaboration in the research priorities of the faculty (www.vetmed.uni-leipzig.de/forschung/forschungsschwerpunkte) and university (www.uni-leipzig.de/en/research/research-profile/strategic-orientation-of-our-research; www.uni-leipzig.de/en/newsdetail/artikel/strategic-research-profiling-leipzig-university-designates-eleven-emerging-fields-along-the-leipzig-way-2025-12-17) and the development of interdisciplinary and international clusters are expressly desired.

A teaching and research concept demonstrating the relevance of the planned projects to the research priorities of the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine and other university institutions should be submitted with the application.

Requirements
In addition to in-depth knowledge of classical animal hygiene combined with modern, technology-based strategies for disease control, outstanding research and publication achievements, particularly in the fields of animal hygiene and/or infection epidemiology, experience in teaching and the successful acquisition of competitive third-party funding, especially international joint research projects are expected. Extensive experience in teaching and postgraduate continuing education and training, experience in personnel management and development are required. Proof of a veterinary licence and approval as a veterinary specialist for animal hygiene or in a relevant field, as well as proof of a postdoctoral qualification or equivalent achievements, must be provided.

The job holder’s rights and obligations are regulated by the Saxon Higher Education Act (SächsHSG) and the Saxon Service Regulations for Higher Education Institutions (HSDAVO). Applicants must meet the requirements of § 59 SächsHSG.

Research, teaching, transfer, infrastructure and administration require a diversity of perspectives. The university is therefore committed to diversity and equal opportunities. We welcome your application, regardless of gender, nationality, religion, cultural and social background, age or sexual orientation. The university aims to increase the proportion of women in academia and therefore expressly encourages qualified women to apply.

Severely disabled persons – or persons deemed legally equal to them under Book IX of the German Social Code – are encouraged to apply and will be given preference in the case of equal suitability. If you have any questions about accessibility or need assistance with this application process, please contact Leipzig University’s disability officers at: schwerbehindertenvertretung@uni-leipzig.de.

Please apply in English by 17 September 2026 exclusively via Leipzig University’s recruitment portal (http://www.uni-leipzig.de/berufungen)

Leipzig University
Dean of the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine 
Prof. Dr. Dr. Thomas Vahlenkamp

About Heraeus

Making displays foldable? Helping hearts beat with medical innovations? Or breathing new life into precious metals? As a family-owned global technology group we help our customers to always being one step ahead.

With sites in the United States, European Union, and Asia, and over 2,200 employees worldwide, together, we will meet tomorrow's challenges today.

- You work in many areas of interventional devices, including access devices, advanced diagnostic and therapeutic catheters and complex delivery systems, applying state-of-the-art technology.
- In your role, you are the technical lead in development projects for catheters and other interventional devices with a customer-specific design from concept freeze throughout product design and manufacturing transfer to the manufacturing sites.

Ultrasonic Acoustic Engineer (m/f/d)

Sound Propagation, Resonance & Biofouling Prevention

HASYTEC (Ultrasonic Tech GmbH, part of the ERMA TECH Group) develops and markets highly innovative ultrasonic technology that prevents biofouling on fluid-carrying surfaces. Our systems protect more than 300 ships, offshore platforms, and maritime installations worldwide against barnacles, algae, and mussels—efficiently, sustainably, and with minimal maintenance.

To strengthen our development team, we are looking for an Ultrasonic Acoustics Engineer who is passionate about understanding sound propagation, resonance behaviour and ultrasonic systems in complex maritime structures.

You will help develop the next generation of ultrasonic anti-fouling technology.

Our long-term goal is to protect not only piping systems and sea water equipment, but also large ship hull structures through controlled ultrasonic resonance fields.

Your responsibilities include:

- Analyze ultrasonic wave propagation in maritime structures and materials
- Investigate resonance behaviour in piping systems, sea chests, strainers, box coolers, propeller systems and hull structures
- Develop and optimize ultrasonic transducer configurations and installation concepts
- Plan, execute and evaluate laboratory experiments and onboard vessel trials
- Measure vibration behaviour and acoustic transmission using modern test equipment
- Analyze experimental data and derive practical design improvements
- Collaborate with hardware, software and mechanical engineering teams
- Coordinate technical activities with universities and research institutes

Technical Qualifications

- Degree in Physics, Acoustics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related field
- Experience in one or more of the following: - Ultrasonics
- Acoustics
- Vibration analysis
- Resonance behaviour
- Signal processing
- Experimental testing
- Experience with laboratory measurement equipment such as oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers or vibration measurement systems
- Experience in data analysis using Python, MATLAB or similar tools
- Experience in maritime systems, fluid-carrying structures or piezoelectric technology is beneficial but not required
- Analytical and systematic working style
- Curiosity for understanding physical phenomena
- Hands-on mentality and enthusiasm for experimental work
- Ability to bridge theory and practical application
- Team-oriented mindset and initiative
- Our working language is English

What Makes This Role Unique

This is not a standard engineering position.

You will work on challenging acoustic problems involving sound propagation, structural resonance and ultrasonic excitation in real maritime applications.

The role combines physics, experimentation, onboard testing and collaboration with leading research institutions to develop sustainable technologies for the maritime industry.

What we Offer

- Work with a unique technology that contributes to more sustainable shipping
- A combination of laboratory research, practical testing and real-world applications
- High levels of responsibility and influence within a growing company at the forefront of sustainable technology
- Collaboration with international customers, universities and research institutes
- Modern equipment and short decision-making processes
- A technically strong and motivated, multi-professional international team
- employee benefits such as corporate pension schemes, bikeleasing and more

jobs.occupation: Software Engineer (f/m/d) located in Eindhoven & Dortmund (Software-Architect)
jobs.description:
Your mission Join Innolume

At Innolume, we develop innovative optoelectronic semiconductor technologies that power next-generation communication and sensing applications worldwide.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced Software Engineer (f/m/d) who will work across our locations in Eindhoven and Dortmund and is comfortable traveling regularly between both sites.

In this role, you will modernize our software landscape, develop scalable applications, and connect software with laboratory and manufacturing equipment. Your work will directly support the development and production of cutting-edge photonic semiconductor devices while helping shape the next generation of our digital engineering environment.

If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges and want to see your software making a tangible impact in a high-tech manufacturing environment, we would love to meet you.

Build the Software behind tomorrow's Semiconductor Technology:
• Design, develop and maintain software for automated measurement, equipment control and data acquisition
• Build scalable desktop applications and software architectures for engineering and manufacturing
• Modernise legacy software applications and migrate existing LabVIEW solutions to sustainable software platforms
• Integrate laboratory instruments, manufacturing equipment, databases, MES and ERP systems
• Develop reliable software interfaces and efficient data pipelines
• Improve software quality, maintainability and performance using modern engineering principles
• Troubleshoot complex software-hardware interactions in close collaboration with engineering teams
• Work closely with Production, Process Engineering, Quality and IT to deliver reliable software solutions
• Contribute to the digital transformation of semiconductor manufacturing

Your profile
• Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering or a related technical field
• Several years of professional software development experience
• Strong programming skills in Python and/or C# (C++ is an advantage)
• Solid understanding of software architecture, object-orientated programming and modern software engineering principles
• Experience developing desktop applications
• Experience with SQL databases and data management
• Familiarity with Git and collaborative software development workflows
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Fluent English language skills (spoken and written)

Nice to have
• German language skills are an advantage
• Experience with laboratory automation or industrial software
• Experience integrating laboratory instruments or manufacturing equipment
• Knowledge of MES, ERP or industrial communication interfaces
• Experience migrating legacy software systems
• Familiarity with Industry 4.0, process monitoring, or machine learning
• Experience in the semiconductor industry

Why us?What we offer:
• Exciting software projects in a highly innovative semiconductor environment
• The opportunity to shape a modern software platform with long-term impact
• An international, interdisciplinary team with flat hierarchies
• Short decision-making paths and a collaborative working culture
• Professional development and continuous learning opportunities
• Flexible working hours and an attractive compensation package

Join Innolume and help us develop the software that powers the next generation of photonic semiconductor technologies.
Career starters, graduates, and candidates with initial professional experience are encouraged to apply.?
We look forward to receiving your application.
Please send your complete application documents to jolanta.rzesa@innolume.com
Innolume GmbH
Konrad-Adenauer-Allee 11 | 44263 Dortmund
www.innolume.com

About usInnolume is an internationally operating specialist for GaAs-, InAs- & InP-based laser diodes. As part of our team you will be able to work on innovative projects from all over the world.
Our team of experts is always there to help you learn and hone your skills. We offer plenty of opportunities and room for personal and professional development.
We want to work in a motivating, social environment - which is why we take great care to provide it. A familial work culture and frequent team events are central to this.
Whether you are new to the field or an experienced employee: We are always searching for new talents to train and integrate into our team of experts. We offer full time positions as well as various internships.

jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
Are you a business-oriented consultant, facilitator, and trainer who can translate strategic needs into impactful Data & AI upskilling initiatives? Join the Data X Academy, where you will help employees, business functions, managers, and leaders strengthen their ability to understand, adopt, and apply Data & AI in practical business contexts.
In this role, your contribution is not developing machine learning models or AI use cases.  Instead, you will design and deliver learning experiences, support business-focused Data & AI adoption, work closely with Data Scientists and subject matter experts, and help translate technical expertise into practical enablement for business audiences. You will connect business understanding, training delivery, stakeholder engagement, agile ways of working, and change enablement to create measurable learning and adoption impact.
The Data X Academy is Boehringer Ingelheim's global capability-building partner for Data & AI. We help people, teams, and leaders understand, apply, build, and lead with Data & AI, responsibly and with a clear connection to business value.
This position can be filled in Ingelheim.
This position has a hybrid setup with approximately 2-3 days per week on site.
Requirements

- Master's degree in Business Informatics, Information Technology, Learning & Development, Organizational Development, Economics, Natural Sciences, Business Administration (or a related field) or a bachelor's degree with more relevant professional experience is also
- Several years of professional experience in business consulting, business partnering, capability building, learning design, change management, or related functions.
- Proven ability to design and facilitate engaging trainings, workshops, learning journeys, and enablement programs for diverse stakeholder groups.
- Strong stakeholder management, consulting, communication, and facilitation skills, with the ability to translate business needs and complex topics into practical, business-oriented solutions.
- Experience working in complex, cross-functional environments, applying agile ways of working and driving organizational transformation, capability building, and Data & AI adoption
- Experience in Learning & Development, adult education, instructional design, or enterprise-wide capability building initiatives as well as in in change management, stakeholder engagement, community building, innovation management, and Data & AI adoption support is desirable
- Experience or certification in innovation, transformation, coaching, and organizational development methodologies (e.g., Design Thinking, Systems Thinking, Strategic Foresight, OKRs, Holacracy, or systemic/agile coaching) is an advantage
- Fluent English required, German language skills are a plus

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Ready to contact us?
If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com
Recruitment process:
Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until September 10th, 2026. We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand.
Step 2: Virtual meeting until end of September
Step 3: On-site interviews beginning end of September / beginning of October
Please submit your application documents in English.

Saarland University is a campus university with an international reputation for research excellence, particularly in computer science and in the life sciences and nanosciences. The university is also distinguished by its close ties to France and its strong European focus. Around 17,000 students, studying over one hundred different academic disciplines, are currently enrolled at Saarland University. Saarland University is officially recognized as one of Germany’s family-friendly higher-education institutions and with a combined workforce of more than 4000 it is one of the largest employers in the region.

The Centre for Language, Cognition and Computation (CLaCC) is inviting applications for the following position commencing the earliest possible time.

Academic research assistant (m/f/x)

Reference number W2904, salary in accordance with the German TV-L salary scale1, pay grade: E13 TV- L, duration of employment: until 31.12.2028, volume of employment: 100 % of standard working time.

Workplace/Department:

Text+ is a collaborative project funded under the National Research Data Infrastructure (NFDI; text-plus.org/). As part of Text+, you will be part of a geographically distributed network of research groups, focusing on the integration of large language models (LLMs) into data preparation and analysis in the field of Digital Humanities (DH). At Saarland University, you will be based at the Centre for Language, Cognition and Computation (ClaCC) and be part of Prof. E. Teich’s research group within the Department of Language Science and Technology (LST; www.uni-saarland.de/fachrichtung/lst.html).

Job requirements and responsibilities:

• Application and comparison of language models for specific digital humanities tasks (e.g. text annotation)

• Adaptation of language models to different registers/text types

• Evaluation of language models with regard to bias

• Development of LM-based processing pipelines for users in the humanities

• Publication record in relevant areas

Your academic qualifications:

• Completed university studies in computational linguistics, digital humanities or computer science

• Language skills (according to GER): Fluent in spoken and written German and English (C1)

The successful candidate will also be expected to:

• Have excellent knowledge of how to use large language models, particularly in the field of digital humanities

• Have solid programming skills, particularly in Python

• Have experience with relevant platforms, e.g. PyTorch, spaCy

• Have teamwork skills

•Language skills (according to GER): The working language of the Text+ Consortium is German, so a very good command of German is required. In addition, a very good command of English (C1) is required.

What we can offer you:

• A flexible work schedule allowing you to balance work and family, among other things the possibility of teleworking

• Secure and future-oriented employment with attractive conditions

• A broad range of further education and professional development programmes (for example language courses)

• An occupational health management model with numerous attractive options, such as our university sports programme

• Supplementary pension scheme (RZVK)

• Discounted tickets on local public transport services (‘Job-Ticket‘ of the saarVV)

We look forward to receiving your meaningful online application (in a PDF file) by 04.09.2026 to clacc@uni-saarland.de Please include the reference number W2904 in the subject line of the e-mail.

If you have any questions, please contact us for assistance. Your contact:

Frau Prof. Dr. Elke Teich.

FR LST, UdS campus, clacc@uni-saarland.de

Pay grade classification is based on the particular details of the position held and the extent to which the applicant meets the requirements of the pay grade within the TV-L salary scale. Part-time employment is generally possible.

If you have obtained a foreign university degree, a proof of the equivalence of this degree with a German degree by the Zentralstelle für ausländisches Bildungswesen (ZAB) is needed before hiring. If necessary, please apply for this in time. You can find more information at https://www.kmk.org/zeugnisbewertung.

Unfortunately, neither costs for attending an interview at Saarland University nor costs for any certificate evaluation by the ZAB can be reimbursed in principle.

We welcome applications regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, disability, age, and sexual orientation and identity. In accordance with its policy of increasing the proportion of women, the University actively encourages applications from women. Applications from severely disabled persons will be given preferential consideration in the event of equal suitability.

When you submit a job application to Saarland University you will be transmitting personal data. Please refer to our privacy notice for information on how we collect and process personal data in accordance with Art. 13 of the Datenschutz-Grundverordnung. By submitting your application you confirm that you have taken note of the information in the Saarland University privacy notice
